query_analysis.original_query: I am struggling to understand why the injection of water make-up suddenly decreases the desorption tower by a significant percentage ? is it related to the heat loss or more like an error in the DCS ?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate the root cause of performance reduction in a desorption tower following water make-up injection, exploring potential factors including heat transfer dynamics and distributed control system (DCS) functionality

selected_agents.role: Root cause investigation of performance decline
Heat transfer and thermal performance analysis
DCS functionality and potential system error verification

communication_strategy.information_flow: Cross-domain diagnostic investigation and hypothesis testing
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Sequential problem decomposition and integrated systems analysis

clarification_questions: What was the exact percentage decrease in the desorption tower's performance?
Can you provide the specific temperature and pressure conditions before and after the water make-up injection?
Are there any recent maintenance records or changes in the DCS configuration?
What is the typical water make-up composition and temperature?
